notes.title: Corona Simulator Halloween Update Is Here!
notes.content:
Sorry that I didn't update earlier, but I was very busy with my other project [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i7iLIdc6ZAA&list=PLnIw66gYX3s495RQ5qtvZCP5oxoPG8NcC&index=55]Raidborn[/url], I am working on for nearly two years now. But back to the topic. The [b]Halloween Update[/b] brings the requested [b]save feature[/b] into the game, so whenever you leave the game now, it will [b]automatically save[/b] your progress and you can continue at any time, which is especially helpful at harder difficulties as one round can take up to an hour. Additionally, I also did some [b]heavy rebalancing[/b], with the goal to make each resource equally useful. I think the update will make the game a [b]much better[/b] experience. For the future I also plan to make a larger update, bringing [b]more content[/b] and completely [b]new features[/b], together with a relaunch of the game, so stay excited.

[b]Update in a nutshell:[/b]
[list]
[*] New save feature
[*] Events rebalanced
[*] Measures rebalanced
[*] Bugfixes
[/list]

P.S.: You would do me a great favor, if you could write a review for the game. Thank you!

Stay cool
Markus (Phodex Games)
